name: Reset Password to Sign In
summary: The user submits a new password from a valid reset-link session, the server updates the credential, and the client returns to password sign-in.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.complete is visible with a valid password-reset token

inputs.name: New Password
inputs.description: New password supplied through the test runner's secure settings.

inputs.name: Confirm Password
inputs.description: Confirmation of the new password supplied through the test runner's secure settings.

serverInteraction.intent: Validate the password-reset token, update the user's password credential, invalidate the token, and return the user to sign-in.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password is visible with the password credential updated
